digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown / snapshot cache cleanup
propositions: macOS CI cleanup failed when snapshot-producing tests outside tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py left read-only .rebar/run_snapshots directories that survived pytest teardown

snapshot publication intentionally applies 0444/0555 permissions via _chmod_readonly, but cleanup was owned only by a module-local fixture, leaving non-removable cache roots when other test modules produced snapshots
ordinary shutil.rmtree raises PermissionError on residual read-only .rebar/run_snapshots trees, but snapshot._rmtree_writable successfully removes them by restoring write permissions

the fix moves snapshot cache teardown from tests/unit/workflow/test_snapshot.py to shared tests/conftest.py as an autouse fixture that searches for and removes only .rebar/run_snapshots roots below each test-owned tmp_path
